_paper.citation: Chen, H., Chen, Z., Dhaliwal, D. S., & Huang, Y. (2017/2020). Accounting Restatements and Corporate Cash Policy. Journal of Accounting, Auditing & Finance, 35(2), 290-317.
_paper.main_did_table: Table 3, Panel A (Baseline Model) and Panel B (Expanded Model)

CASH.verbatim_definition: the level of cash holdings, defined as cash and short-term investments (Compustat data item #CHE) scaled by total assets (#AT)
CASH.units: ratio (cash and short-term investments / total assets)

POST.verbatim_definition: a dummy variable that equals 1 after the restatement, and 0 before the restatement
POST.formula: 1 if t in [+1, +3]; 0 if t in [-3, -1]; year 0 (announcement year) excluded from main test
POST.interpretation_note: Treatment effect is the DIFFERENCE in POST coefficient between restatement-sample regression and control-sample regression (split-sample DiD), not an interaction term.

Q.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
Q.verbatim_definition: Tobin's Q (Q) is defined as the book value of total assets (#AT) plus the difference between the market value of equity (#PRCC_F × #CSHO) and the book value of equity (#CEQ), all scaled by book value of total assets

SIZE.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
SIZE.verbatim_definition: Firm size (SIZE) is the natural logarithm of total assets

CF.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
CF.verbatim_definition: Operating cash flow (CF) is net operating cash flow (#OANCF) scaled by total assets

NWC.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
NWC.verbatim_definition: Net working capital (NWC) is noncash working capital (#ACT − #CHE) − (#LCT − #DLC) scaled by total assets

LEV.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
LEV.verbatim_definition: Leverage (LEV) is the sum of long-term debt (#DLTT) and short-term debt (#DLC) scaled by total assets

SIGMA.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
SIGMA.verbatim_definition: Industry volatility of operating cash flow (SIGMA) is the industry-median value of the standard deviation of operating cash flow over the previous 10 years
SIGMA.compustat_items: Derived from OANCF/AT (CF); industry definition NOT SPECIFIED at baseline (note: cross-sectional tests use Fama-French 48)
SIGMA.units: ratio (std dev of cash flow ratio)

NSEG.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
NSEG.verbatim_definition: Number of business segments (NSEG) is the count of business segments with nonzero identifiable assets, set to 1 if the value is missing
NSEG.compustat_items: Compustat Business Segment file (specific item NOT SPECIFIED)
NSEG.formula: count of segments with nonzero identifiable assets; = 1 if missing
NSEG.transformations: missing-value imputation: set to 1 if missing

AGE.role: control (baseline Panel A and Panel B)
AGE.verbatim_definition: Firm age (AGE) is the natural logarithm of the number of years since the firm first appeared in Compustat

CAPX.verbatim_definition: CAPX is capital expenditure (#CAPX) scaled by total assets

ACQUISITION.verbatim_definition: ACQUISITION is acquisition (#AQC) scaled by total assets

R&D.verbatim_definition: R&D is research and development (#XRD) scaled by total sales (#SALE)
R&D.missing_value_handling: NOT EXPLICITLY SPECIFIED in this paper, though median of 0.000 in error sample suggests missing R&D may be treated as 0 (common practice). Verify before replication.

DIV.verbatim_definition: DIV is dividends (#DVC) scaled by total assets

DEBT_XFIN.verbatim_definition: DEBT_XFIN is net long-term debt issuance (#DLTIS − #DLTR) plus change in current debt (#DLCCH) scaled by total assets (#AT)

EQUITY_XFIN.verbatim_definition: EQUITY_XFIN is sale of common and preferred stock (#SSTK) scaled by total assets

MATURITY.verbatim_definition: MATURITY is the ratio of long-term debt due within 3 years (sum of #DD1, #DD2, and #DD3) to total long-term debt (#DLTT + #DD1)

NO_LOAN.verbatim_definition: NO_LOAN is an indicator variable that equals 1 if no bank loan was obtained in the fiscal year, and 0 otherwise
NO_LOAN.data_source: DealScan (NOT EXPLICITLY NAMED in paper but standard source for bank loan covenants)
NO_LOAN.formula: 1 if no bank loan obtained; 0 otherwise

N_FINCOV.verbatim_definition: N_FINCOV is the weighted average number of financial covenants...for all bank loans obtained in the fiscal year, where the weight is the deal amount of each loan, both set to 0 when no bank loan was obtained
N_FINCOV.data_source: Bank loan database (NOT EXPLICITLY NAMED; presumably DealScan)
N_FINCOV.formula: deal-amount-weighted average of count(financial covenants); = 0 if no loan
N_FINCOV.transformations: deal-amount weighting; zero-imputation when no loan

N_GENCOV.verbatim_definition: N_GENCOV is the weighted average number of general covenants for all bank loans obtained in the fiscal year, where the weight is the deal amount of each loan, both set to 0 when no bank loan was obtained
N_GENCOV.data_source: Bank loan database (NOT EXPLICITLY NAMED; presumably DealScan)
N_GENCOV.formula: deal-amount-weighted average of count(general covenants); = 0 if no loan
N_GENCOV.transformations: deal-amount weighting; zero-imputation when no loan

BigN.verbatim_definition: BigN is an indicator variable that equals 1 if the annual report is audited by one of the Big 5 (or 4) auditors and 0 otherwise
BigN.data_source: NOT EXPLICITLY NAMED (likely Compustat AU code or Audit Analytics)

sample_construction.restatement_source: Hennes, Leone, and Miller (2008), which compiles restatements disclosed in GAO (Government Accountability Office) reports GAO-03-138 (2003) and GAO-06-678 (2006)

filters_applied.filter: Subsequent restatements (keep only first per firm)
Missing financial data, cash > total assets, total assets or market value of equity < $10 million, growth in assets or sales > 100%, or missing PSM variables

sample_construction.event_window: [-3, -1] pre-restatement vs. [+1, +3] post-restatement; year 0 (announcement year) excluded from main test

psm_matching.specification: Pr(RESTATE=1) = B1*X1 + B2*X2 + B3*X3 + industry FE + year FE + e
psm_matching.covariate_measurement_window: Mean over years t-3 to t-1 (relative to restatement year 0)
psm_matching.matching_method: Same Fama-French 48 industry, closest propensity score in year 0; without replacement; if multiple restatement firms match the same control, the pair with smallest propensity-score difference is kept and the matching is repeated
psm_matching.diagnostics_after_matching: Probit pseudo-R² = 0.007 (vs 0.101 pre-matching); model p-value ≈ 1.000 (vs <.001); only BigN remains marginally significant at 10% across 20 covariates

econometric_specification.estimation: Estimated SEPARATELY on restatement subsample and control subsample (split-sample DiD). Treatment effect = β_restatement - β_control, with joint inference run with both regressions estimated simultaneously.
econometric_specification.fixed_effects: Firm fixed effects (α_i). No year fixed effects in baseline (POST already captures time variation in event time).
econometric_specification.standard_errors: Two-way clustered at (i) matched pair (of the restatement and control firms) and (ii) year levels, following Gow, Ormazabal, and Taylor (2010)
econometric_specification.test_of_treatment_effect: Joint estimation of restatement and control regressions to test the difference in POST coefficients; p-values reported in 'Test of difference in the coefficient of POST' row

data_treatment.winsorization: NOT SPECIFIED IN PAPER. The paper applies DROPS rather than winsorization: observations with cash > total assets, or asset/sales growth > 100%, or AT/MVE < $10M are removed entirely.

missing_value_imputation.NSEG: Set to 1 if the value is missing (explicitly stated)
missing_value_imputation.N_FINCOV: Set to 0 when no bank loan was obtained (explicitly stated)
missing_value_imputation.N_GENCOV: Set to 0 when no bank loan was obtained (explicitly stated)
missing_value_imputation.NO_LOAN: Indicator captures the missing-loan case (no imputation per se)
missing_value_imputation.R&D: NOT EXPLICITLY STATED in this paper. The median of 0.000 in the error sample is consistent with the common convention of setting missing R&D to 0, but the paper does not say so.

data_treatment.scaling: Most ratio variables scaled by total assets (#AT); R&D scaled by sales (#SALE); MATURITY scaled by total long-term debt

summary_stats_table_caveat.note: Table 1 Panel B reports ONLY mean and median. SD, p25, and p75 are NOT in the paper. If you need these for replication, you must compute them yourself on the constructed sample.
